# Machine Learning CS301 Syllabus

## Course Information
Instructor: Professor Sarah Smith. Email: sarah.smith@university.edu.
Office hours: Tuesdays 14:00-16:00 in Room 4.219.

## Assessment
Assignment 4 is due October 13 at 23:59.
The midterm examination is scheduled for October 20 during class.
Late submissions are penalized 10% per day.

## Weekly Topics
Week 1: Introduction to machine learning, linear regression.
Week 2: Regularization, bias-variance tradeoff.
Week 3: Neural networks fundamentals.
Week 4: Convolutional neural networks. CNN architectures: LeNet, ResNet.
Week 5: Recurrent networks and attention.
Week 6: Transformers and pretraining.
Week 7: Midterm review session.

## Policies
Academic honesty is required. Collaboration on assignments must be declared.
